Chief Standing Counsel for respondent Nos. 2 
and 3. 
Mr. Vinay Kumar, learned counsel for 
respondent No. 4. 
Learned counsel for respondent No. 1 
submits that the appeal is barred by 
limitation. This submission is premised on 
the fact that the impugned order was passed
in the writ petition on 10.06.2022. 
The appellant had preferred a review 
application, which was dismissed on 
21.07.2022, where after the present appeal 
has been preferred. 
In the aforesaid circumstances, even if 
there is a technical delay in filing of the 
present appeal, we are inclined to condone 
the same. 
SPECIAL APPEAL NO. 300 of 2022 
Issue notice.  Mr. B.D. Kandpal, learned counsel 
appears and accepts notice on behalf of 
respondent No. 1. 
Mr. Anil Kumar Bisht, learned Additional 
Chief Standing Counsel for the State, 
appears and accepts notice on behalf of 
respondent Nos. 2 and 3. 
Mr. Vinay Kumar, learned counsel 
appears and accepts notice on behalf of 
respondent No. 4. 
The respondents may file their response 
to the averments made and documents filed 
along with the review application in the writ 
petition. The same be filed within four 
weeks. Rejoinder within two weeks. 
Further steps taken regarding
appointment of respondent No. 4 shall be 
subject to further orders in the Appeal. 
List the matter on 13.03.2023. 
 
 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) (Vipin Sanghi, C.J.)

Hon’ble Vipin Sanghi, C.J.
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J. 
Mr. Tarun Mohan, learned counsel for 
the appellant. 
Mr. Pradeep Joshi, learned Additional 
Chief Standing Counsel for the State / 
respondent Nos. 2 and 3. 
Mr. Vinay Kumar, learned counsel for 
respondent No. 4. 
We have heard learned counsels at 
some length. 
In our view, it is essential to implead All 
India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) 
as a party respondent to clarify whether the 
diploma obtained by the appellant from the 
India Air Force could be considered as 
equivalent qualification for the purpose of 
recruitment to the post of Regional Inspector 
(Transport). 
Let the appellant take steps to file the 
amended memo of parties, and for issuance 
of notice to AICTE, returnable on 
10.05.2023. 
In the meantime, we direct the 
respondent State to file its affidavit clearly 
stating whether the qualification of the  appellant is considered as equivalent 
qualification for the purpose of the aforesaid 
recruitment. 
The affidavit be filed by the State within 
three weeks. 
List the matter on 10.05.2023. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) (Vipin Sanghi, C.J.)
